title: Kiritani Haruka — An Idol To Be Proud Of〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: An Idol To Be Proud Of（4★）

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh! MEIKO, KAITO, hello.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome, Haruka♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You look like you're in a good mood.
Did something nice happen?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, actually. We got a job request in for the first time in a while. It's just for a local radio station, though.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you thinking you'll take it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. We'll have a proper meeting with the client soon, so we'll respond officially then.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It sounds like they reached out to us after seeing Shizuku's commercial, so I want to be sure to deliver what they're looking for.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I hope this leads to a lot more work coming your way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't want to make my mom and dad worry, after all...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your parents?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The thing is, whenever we appear on TV, I ask my parents to be sure to record it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: With no requests coming in, I haven't had anything to ask them to record for us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They've noticed, of course, and they seem a little concerned.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If I told them the truth, that we're not getting any work at all, I know they would be worried for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I've just said we're focusing on streaming and finding our future direction right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I haven't lied to my parents. Not really.
We just wrapped up the “MORE MORE WEEK” plan of streaming every day for a week in a row, after all.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I can't play the current situation off forever.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I just hope we get more offers in like this radio job, so I don't have to anymore...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That light just now...
That looked like feeling sparks.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think you're right about that. Look, see there...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're right.
It must be a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This glass shard is a fragment of a feeling? But the one I saw before was round...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they're meant to be round. So this is more like a... A shard of a feeling, I suppose?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, something feels strange about this. Suddenly glowing like that... It's like it wanted us to find it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When you touch a fragment of a feeling, you can find out what emotion gave birth to it, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If I touch it, maybe we'll learn more.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You mean to enter its SEKAI, then?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Like KAITO said, I feel like it's not a coincidence we found it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay then! In that case, we'll come with you♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: MEIKO, KAITO, thank you both!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, here we go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So this is the SEKAI of that shard of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's so misty, I can't see very much... But there's greenery here. It seems like a nice place.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right.
Hm?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Aah! Th-There's someone there!
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? This girl reminds me of Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's... Me, when I was little...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka?
rows.Line: Good for you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka?
rows.Line: You didn't make Mommy and Daddy sad this time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka?
rows.Line: But we will make them sad again, for sure.

rows.Speaker: Haruka?
rows.Line: As long as I'm an idol...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's not...

rows.Speaker: Haruka?
rows.Line: If you really love Mommy and Daddy...

rows.Speaker: Haruka?
rows.Line: Then you should quit being an idol forever.
se_run_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait!
se_run_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I-I can't see!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank goodness! Haruka, are you o...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait... Something feels different.
Where did she go? The little me...
Huh? Why am I over there?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, are you Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, that's right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO & MEIKO
rows.Line: Haruka and Haruka swapped bodies?!
